annotation.authors_or_issuer: Tanqueray, L.; Castellano, G.; Larsson, S.
annotation.summary_en: Two-page workshop abstract proposing an interdisciplinary socio-legal HRI approach to normative gender aspects of automating perinatal depression care in socially assistive robots, so robots can normatively adapt to patients, support trustworthy assistance and reduce social prejudice attached to the condition.
key_provisions_or_claims: Interdisciplinary approach needed to understand gender norms in perinatal depression care by robots.
Socially assistive robots should 'normatively adapt' to the patient.
Gender norms should be considered at the design stage.
Trustworthy automated perinatal depression assistance requires addressing social prejudices.
annotation.title_clean: A Preliminary Case Study on Gender Norms in Robot-Assisted Diagnosis of Perinatal Depression: A Socio-Legal HRI Perspective
annotation.title_en: A Preliminary Case Study on Gender Norms in Robot-Assisted Diagnosis of Perinatal Depression: A Socio-Legal HRI Perspective
